children: look to tap 2,768 cr Our Bureau Mumbai: Five mainboard and four SME initial public offerings (IPOs) will open for subscription next week, collectively seeking to raise 2,768 crore. EAAA India Alternatives will be the largest mainboard offering, aiming to raise 1,200 crore, followed by SFC Environmental Technologies at 667.53 crore and MK Sons Fine Jewels at 275.40 crore. BLS Polymers and Bombay Coated & Special Steels will seek to raise 255 crore and 183.06 crore, respectively.

In the SME segment, Wiscon Industries, Ajwa Projects, Carver Roboweld and Antala Industries will open their IPOs next week. Core4 Engineers, whose IPO opened last week, will close for subscription on October 27. Two mainboard companies are also scheduled to list on October 28. These include Jio Platforms, which raised more than 30,000 crore through its IPO last week, and Paras Healthcare, which raised around 1,450 crore.

title: IPO Season's in Full Swing, 9 More Cos to Hit the Street
